drivers.explanation: Active patients are growing and the account is healthy on delivery metrics, with no open escalations, no Sev1 tickets, and invoices paid on time.
Active patients sit at 1,670 against 1,800 contracted, and forecast attainment is 92.8%, so there is a modest gap to close before renewal, though it is not a churn signal on its own.
Only 4 weekly portal users, flat over 90 days, means the brand team is not engaging with program data, which is a watch item for renewal.

tool_input.next_step: Schedule an executive business review this week to confirm the brand team's priorities and review the path from 1,670 toward the 1,800 contracted patients, and ask about portal training for the brand team.
